title: Polynomial switch-chain mixing for all degree sequences
exact_target: For every graphical degree sequence of a finite simple undirected n-vertex graph, does the lazy degree-preserving switch chain on all its labeled realizations mix to its uniform stationary law in polynomial time, with $t_mix\leq 2n^{8}$ and gap at least $[24n^{2}\cdot binom(n,4)]^{-1}$ whenever there is more than one realization?
